appDescription.message: Simple subtitle export for Mnet Plus.

noActiveTab.message: Unable to access the current tab.

baseHint.message: Nothing is selected by default. Choose the subtitle tracks you need, generate them first, then save them from the temporary resources section.

empty.message: No subtitle resources have been generated yet.

cacheHint.message: Generated subtitles are temporarily stored in the current video tab. Refreshing the page, closing this tab or browser, or switching to another Mnet Plus video will clear the cache. Save any subtitles you need in time.

saveStarted.message:
Save started: $FILENAME$
If you cancel the system save dialog, the resource will remain available and can be saved again.

batchSave.message: Started saving $COUNT$ subtitle file(s). Cancelling a system save dialog will not delete the temporary resource.

batchDelete.message: Deleted $COUNT$ subtitle file(s) from the temporary cache.

clearConfirm.message:
Clear all $COUNT$ generated subtitle file(s)?
You will need to generate them again after clearing.

wrongPage.message: Open an Mnet Plus video page first, then click the extension.

unrecognized.message: Unable to detect the current page

chooseOne.message: Select at least one subtitle track.

replacing.message:
Generating: $LANGUAGES$
Existing cache for $REPLACING$ will be regenerated and replaced.

complete.message: Generation complete. Subtitles are now in the temporary resources section below, where you can save them individually or use batch actions.
